name: Secret Sign (Orphaned Bookworm Productions)
body:
School enchantment; Level bard 1, inquisitor 0, occultist 1, ranger 1, sorcerer/wizard 1, psychic 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one intelligent creature
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

Using discreet hand signals, body language, or the shuffling of nearby objects you are able to convey a short message of twenty five words or less without speaking. Your target understands your message perfectly as long as you share a language and knows that you sent the message. If you send a message in this way to a creature with whom you share no languages they can only understand clear emotional pleas such as help or danger . You can use this spell even if you are bound and gagged.
